# CLI

The `entlite` binary. In a generated project every command is wired into a `go:generate` line, so `go generate ./...` inside `ent/` runs the whole pipeline.

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `new` | Scaffolds an ent directory, one schema file per entity. |
| `gen` | Writes the sqlc and proto contracts from a schema directory. |
| `sqlc-wrap` | Writes the typed wrappers around the code sqlc generated, run it from the ent directory. |
| `proto-validate` | Writes the Validate methods for the generated proto types, run it from the ent directory. |

## new

Scaffolds an ent directory, one schema file per entity.

```bash
entlite new [-dialect postgresql|sqlite|mysql] <Entity>...
```

| Flag | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-dialect` | `postgresql` | SQL dialect: postgresql, sqlite, or mysql |

## gen

Writes the sqlc and proto contracts from a schema directory.

```bash
entlite gen <schema dir>
```

## sqlc-wrap

Writes the typed wrappers around the code sqlc generated, run it from the ent directory.

```bash
entlite sqlc-wrap
```

## proto-validate

Writes the Validate methods for the generated proto types, run it from the ent directory.

```bash
entlite proto-validate
```
